about.title: Personal Injury Help in Belvedere, California
about.longDescription: Belvedere is a small island city of about 2,121 people, tucked along the Marin County shoreline, with most local traffic moving through Peninsula Road, Bayview Avenue, Graham Avenue, and Beach Road. According to the most recent final state data, Belvedere recorded zero injury collisions, zero people injured, and zero traffic deaths in 2023 — a reflection of the city's small size and low-speed streets. That doesn't mean crashes never happen here, or that residents commuting into busier parts of Marin County, San Rafael, or across the bridge into San Francisco are immune from getting hurt. When something does happen — a rear-end collision on a coastal road, a slip on a wet dock, a bike accident near the water — LawProactive is here to help. We are a free connection service, not a law firm. We don't handle cases ourselves; we simply connect injured people with an independent personal injury attorney in our network who works on contingency, meaning there's no fee unless you recover compensation. There's no obligation to move forward, and reaching out costs nothing.

whyChoose.title: What to Know Before You Wait

items.title: The Clock Is Ticking
items.desc: California law generally gives you two years from the date of an injury to file a claim, though claims against a government entity can require notice in as little as six months. Waiting too long can permanently close the door on compensation.

items.title: Shared Fault Doesn't Shut You Out
items.desc: California follows pure comparative fault, meaning even if you were partly responsible for what happened, you may still recover a reduced amount. Fault is rarely all-or-nothing.

items.title: No Ceiling on Pain and Suffering
items.desc: For most ordinary injury cases in California, there's no cap on non-economic damages like pain, suffering, or loss of enjoyment of life.

items.title: You Don't Pay Unless You Win
items.desc: Attorneys in our network work on contingency, so there are no upfront fees. Payment only comes from a settlement or award, not out of your pocket.

items.question: Is LawProactive a law firm?
items.answer: No. LawProactive is a free service that connects injured people with an independent personal injury attorney. We don't represent clients directly or charge any fees ourselves.

items.question: How much does it cost to use LawProactive?
items.answer: Nothing. Our connection service is completely free, and any attorney you're matched with typically works on contingency, meaning they only get paid if you recover compensation.

items.question: How long do I have to file a claim in California?
items.answer: Generally, you have two years from the date of the injury to file a personal injury claim. If your claim involves a government agency, the deadline can be as short as six months, so it's best not to wait.

items.question: Where do crashes tend to cluster in Belvedere?
items.answer: Public crash records show Belvedere's reported traffic activity concentrated along corridors like Peninsula Road, Bayview Avenue, Graham Avenue, and Beach Road, with reports tending to peak on Fridays between 4 and 6 p.m. These are simply neutral public-record patterns, not a judgment about any particular road.

items.question: What if I was partly responsible for the accident?
items.answer: California's pure comparative fault rule means you can still pursue compensation even if you share some blame, though your recovery may be reduced by your percentage of fault. An independent attorney can help evaluate how fault might apply to your situation.
